server_name.description: Primary domain name for this virtual host.

server_aliases.description: List of additional domain names (aliases) for this virtual host.

document_root.description: Root filesystem path for website content.

port.description: Listen port for this virtual host (e.g., 80 for HTTP, 443 for HTTPS).

ssl_enabled.description: Enable HTTPS/TLS for this virtual host.

ssl_cert_file.description: Path to SSL/TLS certificate file (required if ssl_enabled is true).

ssl_cert_key_file.description: Path to SSL/TLS private key file (required if ssl_enabled is true).

ssl_chain_file.description: Optional path to certificate chain file.

directories.description: List of directory configurations for access control and options.

path.description: Filesystem path (must be absolute). If omitted, defaults to document_root.
